The only test class is `AcceptanceTest`, and the full suite passes with `BUILD SUCCESS`.

## Summary

I implemented the disposable-email-domain rejection for `POST /api/owners`, following the existing Spring conventions and the "single source of truth" pattern already used throughout the codebase.

Changes:

1. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added a `DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS` blocklist (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`) and a static `isDisposableEmailDomain(String email)` helper that compares the domain (text after the last `@`) case-insensitively.
